fields.name: interpolated_values
fields.documentation: Summary points read off the RAW (unfitted) curve by interpolation (v1 `fitless`). A LIST of entries (Jess Haley 2026-10-30 [interpolated values are a list]): one per reading of the curve, the one read from |response| marked by `response_transform`.

fields.name: half_maximum_below
fields.documentation: The independent-variable value BELOW the peak where the response falls to half the maximum (v1 `l50`; on a contrast curve, which only rises, this is C50 -- v1 `interpolated_c50`). -Inf if no such point exists.

fields.name: response_transform
fields.documentation: OPTIONAL: a transform applied to the responses before these values were read off the curve, when it is not the curve as stated ('absolute value': read from |response|, v1 `abs.fitless`). Empty: read from the responses as stated. Jess Haley 2026-10-30 [interpolated values are a list], extending [absolute-value fits are fit entries]: one calculator output is one calculation (T10).
